question: Which type of farming is practiced to meet the needs of the farmer's family?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subsistence farming.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subsistence farming** is practiced to meet the** needs of the farmer's family.**
 
• **Farming** refers to the activity of **cultivating crops** and/or **raising animals for food **or other products.
 
• **Subsistence farming** is a type of farming in which** farmers grow crops** and** raise animals** mainly for their** own consumption**.
 
• Subsistence farming is also known as** self-sufficient farming** or **family farming.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pisciculture farming **is a type of farming in which fish are raised in **artificial ponds or tanks** for commercial purposes.
 
• **Commercial farming** is a type of farming in which** crops and/or animals are grown** or raised for sale in the market.
 
• **Sericulture farming** is a type of farming in which silkworms are raised to produce **silk for commercial purposes.**
